meta.title: Hotel Corali Paros | Sea-view hotel in Piso Livadi
meta.description: Hotel Corali in Piso Livadi, Paros: double and twin rooms and a 70 m² apartment, all with balcony and sea view. Family-run, 279 guest reviews. Book direct.

hero.lead: A family-run hotel above the bay of Piso Livadi. Every room has a balcony and a sea view — with Naxos right across the water.
hero.photoAlt: View through a Cycladic arch over Piso Livadi harbour and Naxos from a Hotel Corali balcony

booking.title: Book direct
booking.perk: Best rate when you book directly with us

intro.title: White, blue and the sound of the harbour.
intro.body: On the quieter east coast of Paros, Corali looks over the bay of Piso Livadi with Naxos across the water. Cross the road for a swim at the little beach in front of us, or walk 300 metres to Logaras. You'll be welcomed by our family, who know the island by heart.

rooms.title: Five ways to see the Aegean
rooms.lead: Every room has a balcony, sea view, air conditioning and daily cleaning.

deluxeDouble.name: Deluxe Double Room
deluxeDouble.text: On the second floor with an amazing view. The private balcony is your own retreat for morning coffee as the sun rises.
deluxeDouble.alt: Deluxe double room with double bed and balcony door to the sea

deluxeTwin.name: Deluxe Twin Room
deluxeTwin.text: On the second floor, with large windows framing the ever-changing seascape and a private sunny balcony.
deluxeTwin.alt: Deluxe twin room with two single beds and sea view

double.name: Double Room
double.text: On the first floor. A cosy double bed and a balcony with fresh sea breeze and a panoramic view of Piso Livadi bay.
double.alt: Double room with double bed, stone wall and balcony door

twin.name: Twin Room
twin.text: On the first floor. Two single beds and a balcony to soak in Piso Livadi bay and the Aegean Sea.
twin.alt: Twin room with two single beds and stone wall

penthouse.name: Penthouse Apartment
penthouse.text: 70 m² on the second floor: two bedrooms, an open, light-filled living space and a pergola terrace above the harbour.
penthouse.alt: Penthouse apartment terrace with pergola overlooking Piso Livadi harbour

rooms.note: “From” prices, low season. The final price is shown when you book.

beaches.title: Where to swim today?
beaches.lead: On Paros the wind decides. See the wind right now in Piso Livadi and which beaches are sheltered — or pick a direction yourself.

village.title: Piso Livadi, the authentic side of Paros
village.body: Charming restaurants and tavernas on the waterfront serving the freshest fish with local wine, café-bars by the sea, and the island's loveliest beaches all around: Logaras, Pounta, New Golden Beach, Golden Beach, Molos.

items.title: 18 km from the port
items.text: From Parikia by bus, taxi or car, on a paved road.

items.title: 17 km from the airport
items.text: We can arrange a transfer for your arrival.

items.title: Ferry to Naxos
items.text: Daily connection to Naxos from the village's little port.

items.title: Island hopping
items.text: Daily excursions to Mykonos, Naxos, Iraklia, Koufonisia, Amorgos and Santorini.
